title: Otter reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Otter body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="28" ry="20" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Otter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="75" rx="18" ry="13" fill="#C4956A"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Face lighter area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#C4956A"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="30" r="6" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#A0704E"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="30" r="6" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#A0704E"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="40" r="4" fill="#2C1810"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="40" r="4" fill="#2C1810"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="39" r="1.5" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="39" r="1.5" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3D2B1F"/>

  <line x1="30" y1="45" x2="42" y2="47" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="49" x2="42" y2="49" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="47" x2="70" y2="45" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="49" x2="70" y2="49" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 52 Q50 55 54 52" fill="none" stroke="#3D2B1F" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x="28" y="62" width="44" height="3" rx="1" fill="#E74C3C"/>
  <path d="M30 62 L30 55 Q50 48 50 55 L50 62 Z" fill="#F39C12"/>
  <path d="M70 62 L70 55 Q50 48 50 55 L50 62 Z" fill="#F1C40F"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="55" x2="50" y2="62" stroke="#E67E22" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="35" y1="57" x2="47" y2="57" stroke="#E67E22" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="59" x2="47" y2="59" stroke="#E67E22" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="57" x2="65" y2="57" stroke="#E67E22" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="59" x2="65" y2="59" stroke="#E67E22" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="63" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#A0704E"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="63" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#A0704E"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M75 80 Q88 78 85 68 Q82 60 78 66" fill="#8B5E3C" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
